page.overview:
Who is Fu?

In Xenoverse 2, Fu serves as an antagonist over the course of the DLC stories, but eventually earns redemption by joining the Time Patrol under the supervision of the Future Warrior. In the Heroes mangas and anime, Fu is the overarching antagonist of the Prison Planet, Universe Creation and New Space-Time War Sagas.

Fu was originally created for Dragon Ball Online and was first shown in a guidebook for the game. However, the game was shut down before Fu made his debut in it.

Fu's new appearance for Big Bang Mission was due to Higuchi requesting that he be made more serious.

Fu is a purple-skinned male with red eyes and white hair. Like members of his race, he possesses pointed ears. As a baby, Fu wears what appears to be a dark purple diaper and a white baby handkerchief. While still a baby, he wears a yellow cap with horns and the symbol of the Time Breakers embedded in it.
